model_annotation: The figure contains two line plots (A and Б) illustrating how two measures change across calendar years. In both plots, the x-axis is labeled “Години” (years) on a linear scale, spanning 2008 to 2021 with labeled ticks at 2008, 2012, 2013, 2017, and 2021. In plot A, the y-axis is labeled “Средни леглодни (дни)” on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 200, 220, 240, 260, and 280 (days), and it shows a single red solid line with black circular markers: the series starts near 278 in 2008, is around 266 in 2012, rises to about 271 in 2013, then drops to about 240 in 2017 and ends near 197 in 2021. In plot Б, the y-axis is labeled “Структурен ефект върху средни леглодни (%)” on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 1.0, 1.5, and 2.0 (percent), and it shows a single red solid line with black circular markers: the series begins around 1.5 in 2008, decreases to about 0.85 in 2012 and about 0.75 in 2013, then increases to roughly 1.3 in 2017 and reaches about 2.3 in 2021.
